name: kaboo
description: Kaboo — browser-based multiplayer card game for friends, via room code.

scripts.dev: bun scripts/dev-secret.mjs && bun run web:build && wrangler dev
scripts.web:check: cd web && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.build: bun run web:build && cd crates/worker && worker-build --release
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace --exclude kaboo-worker && cd web && bun run test
scripts.verify: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --exclude kaboo-worker --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p kaboo-worker --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --exclude kaboo-worker && git diff --exit-code -- web/src/generated && bun run web:check
